item.title: Dem House candidate resolves $55K debt dispute with former mother-in-law before election
item.description: Bob Brooks settled a $55,000 loan dispute with his former mother-in-law, but the terms remain unclear as he campaigns for Pennsylvania's 7th District.

item.title: Americans warn AI will take jobs despite reassuring labor data
item.description: Americans sound the alarm over AI taking jobs, but a Yale Budget Lab report found no link between AI adoption and changes in employment rates.
